<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Device with such name already exists!</span></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>This conflicts with data that already exists.</span></div>

## Why it happens

Names of devices, assets, dashboards and most other items must be unique within the tenant. The item may also be one you cannot see, for example a device assigned to another customer.

## Fix it

Choose another name, or open the existing item instead. As tenant administrator, search **Devices** (or the matching list) for the name to find it.

## Check that it worked

The item is saved.
